Signs you need service

Not sure where to start? Look for these common signs.

Air ducts

  • Dust puffs from vents when the system kicks on
  • Musty or stale odors that return after cleaning the home
  • Visible dust buildup on vent covers and returns
  • Allergy flare ups or more sneezing at home or work
  • Rooms that never seem to reach set temperatures

HVAC

  • Short cycling or the unit never shuts off
  • Hot or cold spots in certain rooms or zones
  • Spikes in energy bills without a change in usage
  • Unusual rattling, grinding, or buzzing noises
  • Ice on lines or weak airflow from vents

Dryer vents

  • Clothes take more than one cycle to dry
  • Laundry room feels unusually hot or humid
  • Burning smell during cycles
  • Lint gathering around exterior vent hood
  • Dryer cuts off mid cycle from overheating

Insulation and attic

  • Rooms over garages feel too hot or too cold
  • Dust streaks or dark lines along ceiling edges
  • HVAC runs longer on mild days
  • Drafty rooms even with windows closed

See two or more of these? It is time to call.

How often should you clean and service

  • Air ducts Every 2 to 4 years for homes, more often with pets or renovations. For offices, set a cycle based on usage and filter changes.
  • HVAC maintenance Twice a year is smart. Cooling check in spring, heating check in fall.
  • Dryer vents Once a year for standard runs. Every 6 months for long or multi unit runs.
  • Filters 1 to 3 months for standard home filters. High MERV or media filters last longer but still need checks.
